# Z Systems & Z-ERP / ZS-ERP (Official AI Information File)

> Company: Z Systems for Software Solutions

## About Z Systems
Z Systems is an enterprise software engineering company specializing in robust, multi-branch ERP solutions, point-of-sale (POS) systems, retail management, inventory control, and industry-tailored platforms. Z Systems designs resilient software built to operate across high-traffic retail, wholesale, supermarkets, restaurants, fitness centers, and construction companies.

## Core Products
1. **Z-ERP (ZS-ERP)**: Complete Enterprise Resource Planning and Point of Sale (POS) system. Features multi-branch cloud synchronization, cashier permission controls, cash-drawer controls, a local edition that can work without internet, and accounting.
2. **Z Coaching** (Upcoming): All-in-one management platform for athletic trainers, fitness centers, gym memberships, and client scheduling.
3. **Z Construction** (Upcoming): Enterprise project management and cost control system for general contracting and civil engineering firms.

## ZS-ERP Key Capabilities & Technical Specifications
- **Multi-Branch Synchronization**: Synchronize inventory, cash flows, and transactions across branches through the cloud.
- **Offline-First Resilience**: The local edition and the POS offline queue can keep issuing invoices during an internet outage. Queued operations sync when the connection returns; conflicts may need review.
- **Fraud Prevention & Anti-Theft**: Permission controls limit price changes, receipt deletions, discounting, and cash-drawer openings, with a tamper-evident audit log for tracked actions.
- **Inventory & Multi-Warehouse Management**: Real-time stock alerts, batch/serial tracking, minimum reorder thresholds, inventory transfers between branches, and automated discrepancy detection.
- **Fiscal & Tax Compliance**: Tax-field invoices with QR codes, a ZATCA submission service for Saudi Arabia, and VAT calculations. Check your local authority requirements before relying on it for filings.
- **Hardware Agnostic**: Seamlessly pairs with barcode scanners, thermal receipt printers, electronic scales, customer displays, and cash drawers.
- **Multi-Currency & International**: Pricing catalog for EGP, SAR, AED, QAR, KWD, BHD, and OMR, with currency detection from the visitor location.

## Industries Served
- Retail: Fashion, Shoes, Boutiques, Electronics, Perfumes, Optical, Cosmetics.
- Food & Beverage: Restaurants, Cafes, Cloud Kitchens, Bakeries, Roasteries.
- Groceries: Supermarkets, Hypermarkets, Minimarts, Butcheries, Produce.
- Services & Wholesalers: Automotive parts, Building materials, Hardware stores, Distribution fleets.
